title: Non-RFID BLACK spool runs out, auto-switch to a second black spool
notes: As 07 with pure black (000000) filament. The ran-out tray's colour #00000000 is also black, so the matcher can pick the empty tray. Runout model: the AMS reports the ran-out tray Empty with tag_uid/tray_uuid zeros and colour #00000000 (to confirm from a real runout); the active tray reads none while it switches.

xfail.reason: the 3MF matches the EMPTY black tray: it is charged the whole print (-75 g), the live spool 0 g, and 'Consumption Not Recorded' fires
